source_locations: Consolidated Condensed Statements of Operations, printed page 3
scope_notes: Products revenue equals CCPG plus DCAI; these are reported segment revenue figures.
Foundry revenue is largely intersegment; adding Products and Foundry without eliminations is incorrect.
DCAI margin is a product-segment margin, not consolidated margin.
Consolidated operating income is reported GAAP; segment profits precede corporate unallocated and intersegment profit eliminations.
Use CCPG, the issuer latest label, rather than silently labeling as old CCG.
No annualization or actual-to-model same-scope claim added.
